text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired — incident_id=inc_2026_06_tail_latency — alert: inference-service.p99_latency > 1500ms across eu-west for 3m. Triggered by route /v1/generate (model: vicuna-13b-quant). Pager: pagerduty-bot
Anna: acked via PagerDuty, I'm on it. picking up handoff from night.
Sam: oncall-check — any recent deploys? I'm seeing a config deploy ~10m ago to route-scaler.
Priya: no deploys from infra in last 30m on those clusters. I can look at autoscaler logs.
DevOps-Bot: Scaling events: nodegroup-eu-west-3 scale_up start=1799998800 end=1799998860 reason=scheduled-burst.
Sam: hmm odd. Metrics show spike in concurrent-requests for chat sessions with long context. p95 bumped moderately, p99 exploded. Could be KV cache miss storm.
Anna: running quick KV cache hit-rate query: `sum(rate(kvcache.get_miss[5m])) / sum(rate(kvcache.get_total[5m]))` — miss-rate jumped from 8% to ~58% at 1799998840.
Priya: that aligns with logs: multiple hosts reporting `kv_lookup timeout` and falling back to cold-loading which increases latency.
CS-Jordan: any customer impact? We just got a ping from enterprise-account @Acme about slow completions. They reported timeouts ~10:19am UTC.
Anna: confirmed some 522 timeouts in frontend logs for Acme tenant but not a full outage — increased completion latency and a few 5xx for large-token requests. Impact window ~1799998825-1799998980.
Sam: mitigation idea: temporarily reroute heavy-context traffic to a compact model variant (vicuna-7b-quant) with cached prefixes enabled; reduces token work and keeps latency down. Can we do an immediate route override?
Priya: we can push a traffic rule with `route-override: {tenant: Acme, path: /v1/generate} -> model: vicuna-7b-quant` via console API. I'll prepare and do a staged roll.
Anna: also propose enabling aggressive KV cache read-retry backoff fix: reduce `kv_read_timeout` from 250ms -> 500ms? that might increase waiting but avoid cold path thrash. Thoughts?
Sam: increasing timeout won't help if underlying DB is overloaded; better to throttle large-context requests for a minute and push reroute.
Priya: executing reroute now for Acme and top 5 noisy sessions. command: `curl -XPOST https://console/api/overrides -d '{"selector":"tenant=Acme","model":"vicuna-7b-quant","reason":"latency-mitigation-1799998888"}'` — rolling out.
DevOps-Bot: Override accepted, rollout started to edge-proxies; 30s to propagate.
Anna: rollback knob ready if we see error increase. Monitoring p99 now.
pagerduty-bot: Pager escalation in 8m if unacked by second responder.
Sam: Sam stepping in as secondary. I'll enable a temporary request-size cap: `max_input_tokens=4096` for the affected route — this should stop very large contexts that spike KV misses. Pushing policy change.
Priya: policy change applied to route in 12s. Telemetry shows initial p99 dropping from ~2.1s -> 0.9s for the rerouted traffic.
CS-Jordan: communicated to Acme: "We've applied temporary routing to a compact model and throttling to reduce latency — we'll follow up with root cause and timeline." Customer acknowledged, wants ETA.
Anna: ETA: continue monitoring for 30m, then we'll consider full rollback once stable for 10m. Creating post-incident note.
Priya: looking at origin of miss storm — I see a mis-specified TTL change in the cache warmer job that ran earlier today, TTL set to 0 for certain prefix keys. That would explain cold misses when warmers evicted entries.
Sam: good catch. Can you revert warmer TTL to previous 24h and re-warm top prefixes?
Priya: reverting now and queuing warm job for high-priority prefixes. Warm job queued id=warm_1799998990.
DevOps-Bot: warm job started, progress 0/120 prefixes.
Anna: monitoring — p99 across region trending down ~800ms and still falling. No further 5xx spikes.
pagerduty-bot: Pager acknowledged by Anna, second responder Sam. Escalation timer cleared.
CS-Jordan: notified Acme of progress and next steps. Requested follow-up postmortem.
Sam: action items: 1) revert warmer TTL (done) 2) validate warmer job coverage for top 1k prefixes 3) add alert for sudden cache-miss-rate delta > 20% in 5m 4) run postmortem and share with CS.
Anna: I'll own the postmortem draft and link to metrics/dashboards. Priya please include warm job logs and the override commands.
Priya: will attach logs and policy diffs.
Anna: closing thread when we reach 10m stable p99 < 700ms and no customer-facing 5xx for 15m. Thanks all — great triage. :thumbsup:
